title: Goals
description: Dark section with a heading, side text and a numbered grid of goals

text.default: Four pillars that shape everything we do — from programme design to community formation.

default.title: Biblical training
default.text: Equipping young Europeans with gifted speakers, Bible teachers, and mentors who will challenge them to deepen their walk with God and sharpen their understanding of Scripture.

default.title: Christian fellowship
default.text: Building a real community of faith across borders — fostering long-lasting friendships rooted in Christ among young people from every corner of Europe.

default.title: Networking opportunities
default.text: Connecting young people to one another and to broader ministry opportunities that equip and empower them to serve boldly in their local communities.

default.title: Leadership responsibilities
default.text: Encouraging the next generation to step up — actively owning leadership roles and partnering with values of excellence, integrity, and service.
